steps.name: core-tree
steps.summary: Pure tree logic in src/core/tree (types.ts: FlatNode/TreeNode reusing db schema; tree.ts: buildTree/flattenTree/addNode/removeNode/moveNode/reorderSiblings, all pure, no React/DB runtime deps). 22 Vitest tests cover round-trip, descendant removal, cycle rejection, sortOrder.

steps.name: nodes-api
steps.summary: nodes CRUD as Route Handlers. src/db/index.ts: server-only runtime Drizzle client (postgres-js + Session pooler, global singleton for dev HMR). app/api/nodes/route.ts (GET list / POST create), app/api/nodes/[id]/route.ts (PATCH partial update / DELETE). Every handler authenticates via Supabase server client (401 if no user), filters/injects userId for isolation; POST/PATCH whitelist+validate fields and never trust client userId; DELETE removes descendants via parent_id ON DELETE CASCADE. lint/build/test (22) all pass.

steps.name: query-hooks
steps.summary: TanStack Query hooks for nodes with optimistic updates. src/app/providers.tsx ('use client', QueryClient in useState) wrapped around children in layout.tsx. src/hooks/nodes.ts: useNodes (GET flat array, consumers nest via buildTree) + useAddNode/useUpdateNode/useRemoveNode/useMoveNode. A shared useOptimisticNodeMutation helper gives every mutation the same lifecycle — cancelQueries, snapshot, immediate cache write, onError rollback, onSettled invalidate — injecting only the fetcher + cache updater. Structural cache edits reuse core/tree addNode/removeNode/moveNode (single source of truth); update is a plain field merge. lint/build/test (22) all pass.

steps.name: plan-panel
steps.summary: Plan panel made functional. src/components/panels/PlanPanel.tsx ('use client') reads the flat list via useNodes and nests it with core/tree buildTree (useMemo), renders a recursive tree, and offers a top-level '+ Add area' entry point (parentId null = Area, ADR-009); shows loading/error/empty states. src/components/PlanNode.tsx is the recursive, indented row: Big 3 toggle (★/☆), inline title edit (uncontrolled, commit on blur/Enter), estimate-minutes input, add-child (CHILD_TYPE maps area>project>task>subtask, subtask self-nests for arbitrary depth) and delete buttons. Every edit goes through the step-2 optimistic hooks (useUpdateNode/useAddNode/useRemoveNode) — no tree logic reimplemented, all UI text English. lint/build/test (22) all pass. Drag/resize/timer deferred to phase 2.
